parameters.query:
SELECT id, user_id, label, address, last_history_id
FROM gmail_accounts
WHERE label = 'personal' AND active = TRUE
LIMIT 1;

SELECT set_user_context('{{ $('Get Gmail Account').item.json.user_id }}'::uuid);
SELECT
  '{{ $json.id }}'::text       AS gmail_message_id,
  '{{ $json.threadId }}'::text AS gmail_thread_id,
  COUNT(*)::int                 AS already_triaged
FROM email_triage_log
WHERE gmail_message_id = '{{ $json.id }}';

SELECT set_user_context('{{ $('Get Gmail Account').item.json.user_id }}'::uuid);
WITH dec AS (
  INSERT INTO ai_decisions (
    user_id, domain, decision, reasoning, inputs, model, prompt_version, related_table
  ) VALUES (
    current_user_id(),
    'email_triage',
    jsonb_build_object(
      'classification',   $conv${{ $json.classification }}$conv$,
      'urgency_score',    {{ $json.urgency_score }},
      'suggested_action', $conv${{ $json.suggested_action }}$conv$
    ),
    $conv${{ $json.reasoning }}$conv$,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'gmail_message_id', $conv${{ $json.gmail_message_id }}$conv$,
      'sender_email',     $conv${{ $json.sender_email }}$conv$,
      'subject',          $conv${{ $json.subject }}$conv$
    ),
    $conv${{ $json.model }}$conv$,
    'phase1-v1',
    'email_triage_log'
  )
  RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO email_triage_log (
  user_id, gmail_account_id, gmail_message_id, gmail_thread_id,
  subject, sender_email, sender_name, received_at,
  classification, reasoning, would_archive, archived, decision_id
)
SELECT
  current_user_id(),
  $conv${{ $json.gmail_account_id }}$conv$::uuid,
  $conv${{ $json.gmail_message_id }}$conv$,
  $conv${{ $json.gmail_thread_id }}$conv$,
  $conv${{ $json.subject }}$conv$,
  $conv${{ $json.sender_email }}$conv$,
  $conv${{ $json.sender_name }}$conv$,
  $conv${{ $json.received_at }}$conv$::timestamptz,
  $conv${{ $json.classification }}$conv$,
  $conv${{ $json.reasoning }}$conv$,
  {{ $json.would_archive }},
  FALSE,
  d.id
FROM dec d
ON CONFLICT (user_id, gmail_message_id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id, classification, decision_id;

parameters.query:
SELECT set_user_context('{{ $('Get Gmail Account').item.json.user_id }}'::uuid);
INSERT INTO urgent_queue (user_id, triage_log_id, summary)
SELECT
  current_user_id(),
  etl.id,
  $conv${{ $('Parse Classification').item.json.subject }}$conv$ || ' — ' || $conv${{ $('Parse Classification').item.json.reasoning }}$conv$
FROM email_triage_log etl
WHERE etl.gmail_message_id = $conv${{ $('Parse Classification').item.json.gmail_message_id }}$conv$
LIMIT 1
RETURNING id, summary;
